digest.component_or_area: LLM gate usage recording and diagnostics
propositions: Gate runs compute loop-vs-breadth signals via failure_usage() but discard them at the write, leaving only token counters persisted
Gate runs with no env var set record nothing at all, forcing operators to run instrumented re-runs to answer tuning questions
The success path never computes tool-call shape at all, asymmetrically blinding non-failure runs
Wiring the existing failure_usage() reducer to both paths and adding duration/ticket fields enables tuning decisions to be made from durable records instead of ephemeral logs
Default sink resolution routes gate-session runs to .rebar/usage.jsonl (repo-local, gitignored) while respecting REBAR_USAGE_LOG override for external collectors
The rendered summarize output must distinguish loop (low distinct/total ratio) from breadth (high ratio) from the durable record alone without re-running
